name: Grand Sport Race

origin.basis: Continental's bicycle tires are marketed from its German site; Germany-made lines are marked 'Handmade in Germany'.

manufacturing.basis: Continental's size table gives no made-in statement for this line.

positioning: Budget all-rounder with a racing contour for tours and training.
weight_basis: Continental claims; a 345 g 25 mm version is also listed.
pressure_note: The product table does not list maximum pressures; use the figure printed on the tire.

availability.note: Continental's official Tmall store sells it in mainland China; Continental's German and US catalogs list it for retailers.

price_observations.market: Continental official Tmall store (德国马牌轮胎官方旗舰店)
price_observations.conditions: Tmall list price before discounts ('优惠前') on 2026-11-01; the listing text does not say whether the option is one tire or a pair. Shipping within mainland China. A store coupon showed CNY 197.64.

caveats: Heavy for its width; owners on XHS describe it as an entry training tire that measures wide.
